draft.brief: Quaestor Operator is a system that pays creators in MUSD on Mezo only for work it has checked and verified. The goal is to explain this to Bitcoin holders who are new to DeFi — what it is, why it matters, and how it works. Good work is clear, credible, and speaks the language of Bitcoiners (self-custody, no selling BTC, verified delivery, no upfront trust). It should avoid generic crypto jargon and focus on the specific value prop: creators get paid only for real, checked work, and businesses only pay for results.
